evaluation: Exact previous asset/date rows restricted by historical feature quality only; all methods same keys
split: Quarterly2023-2026, train label end < quarter start minus20days

changes.quality: Exclude rows whose preceding61 price observations contain invalid quality, nonpositive price or mock; no actual return threshold
changes.raw: Same median LightGBM, unscaled return objective
changes.weighted: Normalized return objective weighted by pre-state scale; equivalent absolute-error units
changes.selected: Only pre2022 selected shocks for stock plus same state
changes.timing: US rate/WTI/VIX STATE levels lag one KRX trading row; retrospective5day shocks and target unchanged; sensitivity not certified release availability
